title: Tiny, cute watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under can -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="82" rx="26" ry="6" fill="#2a4a2a"/>
  
  <!-- body of watering can -->
  <rect x="28" y="38" width="40" height="38" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x="32" y="42" width="12" height="28" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#f47c6e"/>
  <!-- body bottom shade -->
  <rect x="30" y="68" width="36" height="8" rx="6" ry="6" fill="#c0392b"/>
  
  <!-- top rim -->
  <rect x="26" y="34" width="44" height="8" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#ff6b5a"/>
  
  <!-- handle on top -->
  <path d="M38 34 Q38 18 50 18 Q62 18 62 34" fill="none" stroke="#f39c12" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 34 Q38 20 50 20 Q62 20 62 34" fill="none" stroke="#ffc44d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d="M68 44 L86 30 L90 34 L70 50 Z" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <path d="M68 44 L86 30 L88 32 L70 46 Z" fill="#f47c6e"/>
  
  <!-- sprinkle head (rose) -->
  <ellipse cx="90" cy="30" rx="8" ry="7" fill="#f39c12"/>
  <ellipse cx="90" cy="30" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#ffc44d"/>
  <circle cx="87" cy="28" r="1.2" fill="#e67e22"/>
  <circle cx="93" cy="28" r="1.2" fill="#e67e22"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="26" r="1.2" fill="#e67e22"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="32" r="1.2" fill="#e67e22"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="32" r="1.2" fill="#e67e22"/>
  
  <!-- water drops falling -->
  <circle cx="90" cy="42" r="2" fill="#5dade2"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#5dade2"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#5dade2"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="56" r="1.2" fill="#5dade2"/>
  
  <!-- cute face on body -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="52" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="52" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="53" rx="2.2" ry="2.8" fill="#2c3e50"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="53" rx="2.2" ry="2.8" fill="#2c3e50"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="51.5" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="51.5" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="58" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9a9e" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="58" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9a9e" opacity="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 60 Q48 65 52 60" fill="none" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="78" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="78" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#c0392b"/>
</svg>
